description: MEASURED evidence, not only what providers say. For a provider: its official status plus outage.me's own response-time check of its domain against its recent median. For an ISP (e.g. 'Virgin Media', 'Comcast'): its status page when it has one, outage-grade problems from users' consented speed samples, and a link to its free carrier page (which also shows attributed RIPE Atlas latency). For a country (ISO-2): user problems, the carriers and services with problems on that market's board. `missing` lists what could not be checked (country connectivity, BGP and power data are not served through the API yet), so an empty answer is never an all-clear. Pass one or more of provider, isp, country. Deterministic: no model in the loop.
name: network_conditions
title: Network conditions now: a provider, an ISP or a country
